summary: The study reports the deposition of amorphous high k dielectric Bi12x2yTixSiyOz (BTSO) thin films using atomic layer deposition (ALD). The films exhibit high dielectric constants (55-64), low leakage current density (10^-8 A/cm2 at 1 V), and good dielectric breakdown strength (0.6-1.6 MV/cm). The films were grown on Ru/SiO2/Si substrates using Bi(mmp)3, Ti(mmp)4, and Si(OEt)4 as precursors, with ozone as the oxidant. The films showed excellent thickness and compositional uniformity on high aspect ratio structures.
evidence: BTSO ﬁlms grown by atomic layer deposition (ALD) have a dielectric constant of 55-64, which is the highest value reported among amorphous dielectric ﬁlms. Leakage current density of the ﬁlms is on the order of 10^-8 A/cm2 at 1 V with dielectric breakdown strength of 0.6-1.6 MV/cm. Thickness and compositional uniformities on hole structures with a high aspect ratio (7) are also investigated with Bi2Ti2O7 ﬁlms without Si, of which conformality is excellent with respect to both thickness and composition.
